rows.scope: Bounded final independent review of IA12346 only: prior semantic PASS bound to unchanged 48-file candidate, six current/pinned PDFs, original selected-family custody and all 24 original PNG pages. No new source research, acquisition, packet build, raster, shared-output generation or commercial promotion.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.basis: Existing IA route memo, route contract, family identity and PF23 return.
ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The candidate is the statewide Iowa public-intoxication conviction route ia-12346 under Iowa Code section 123.46, using Rule 2.86 Form 3; current family and route-key bindings agree.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.basis: Held source SHA-256/length/page check against SOURCE_RECOVERY_WAVE1 and the six-document receipt.
SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: The held August 2024 Rule 2.86 Form 3 is dd7685c6caf6d87979a31ce1639be6d08067a5c006a3d57eab68c1d097df49a5 / 1415336 bytes / 2 pages. The wave record binds ia-12346-set to this exact existing obligation and every receipt document repeats it. No substitute source was used and MASTER_QUEUE was not treated as source authority.

COMPONENT_SET.basis: Route component contract, source receipt, rendered page manifest and guidance.
COMPONENT_SET.finding: Each packet contains the official two-page Form 3, including embedded page-two service certification, followed by two non-filed instruction pages. No proposed order, DCI report, notary, billing form or separate service binary is added.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.basis: Production field map, six fixture facts, actual-write report and saved-byte readback.
KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: All 122 writes across six fixtures match mapped fixture facts and current output bytes; participant signature, execution date, service date and unsupported facts are not invented.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.basis: Refusal classifications, completeness result, readiness report and participant handoff.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The 17 required-before-filing rows are explicitly classified. The missing-contact fixture identifies its 13 missing contact/service inputs and says DO NOT FILE YET; paper service date and participant execution remain blank, while the eFile branch does not complete the paper certificate.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.basis: Existing route rules, option fixtures and participant instructions.
ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: The two filing branches, statutory public-intoxication/local-equivalent paths, permitted traffic exception and outside-window later-conviction example are represented without unsupported options; guidance warns OWI/321J is not automatically exempt.

REPEATING_ROWS.basis: Current field census/map and six fixture manifests.
REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The Form 3 has no repeated participant row; each fixture has one Form 3 and one instruction component. The 288 source fields plus six synthetic printed-signature rules are covered by the 294-entry map without duplicate map identifiers or dropped source fields.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.basis: Protected refusal ledger and saved blank-ink measurements.
PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: All 45 protected fields remain refused, including participant signature/date/election, paper service date/execution and attorney fields; protected writes and added protected ink are zero.

ARTIFACTS.basis: Current six PDF hashes/lengths/pages, transfer body comparison and saved-byte audit.
ARTIFACTS.finding: All six current PDFs match the rendered report and all 48 Captain transfer bodies; they total 24 pages, have no active widgets, match write values and report zero outside-write glyphs. This is a nonvisual saved-byte pass; raster fit remains pending.

PAGE_ORDER.basis: Rendered page manifests and current PDF page counts.
PAGE_ORDER.finding: Every fixture is ordered Form 3 pages 1-2 followed by participant instructions pages 3-4; source Form 3 order is preserved.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.basis: Direct viewing of all 24 original immutable PNGs from run34765630915 after custody admission; independent hash/length/dimension checks confirm exact inventory bytes.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All six four-page packets are legible and complete. No clipping, overlap, cropped content, missing ink, unintended blank pages, protected-field ink or boundary overflow observed. Missing-contact continuation remains legible; all synthetic/nonfiled instructions and blank execution/service classifications preserved.

FILING_DESTINATION.basis: Existing route memo and participant filing guidance.
FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The route directs filing in the existing Iowa District Court case for the county of the case, through Iowa eFile where available or on paper at the county clerk; no unsupported new-case advice is given.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.basis: Route fee reconciliation and participant fee/debt disclosures.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The unresolved fee status is preserved: no application fee was identified in existing practice input, but case-specific charges must be confirmed. No fee-waiver form or invented fee is added; court debt is stated not to be a precondition and is not forgiven.

SERVICE.basis: Official Form 3 page-two service section, route rules, fixture branches and guidance.
SERVICE.finding: Paper filers receive the embedded certificate and fill the actual service date after mailing/delivery; eFilers are told to verify electronic service and leave the paper certificate unused. No false completed service is asserted.

SELF_HELP_STOP.basis: Participant instructions and existing route limitations.
SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Guidance stops for incomplete/disputed history, timing/category boundary, opposition or contested hearing, and limits claims to confidentiality/off-public-access and the clerk-notice consequence; it directs legal help for contested or out-of-scope facts.
